Every minute, at X:00, a special merchant spawns near the player. This merchant allows the player to exchange the gold they earned during the run for a selection of weapons and the option to level up their weapons. Up to twelve weapons will be available at a time, and what is offered is based on what the player could normally find in level ups. Four slots will give new items, prioritizing weapons and passive items that evolve what the player currently has, while the other eight slots will be levels for existing weapons and passives. This selection can be rerolled using
. The amount of gold required to level up a weapon increases with the weapon's level, and the cost to purchase or level up a weapon is decreased with
. Limit Break levels cannot be purchased at this merchant. This merchant will be marked on the map, and there is no limit to how many can be present at once.

The name of this Darkana is a reference to the song "
", which is the theme song for the
, the first stage in
. Haunted Castle is the first arcade game tied to the Castlevania series, and was released in 1988.
Stake to Your Heart (0) can be unlocked in the
by casting the spell "ottamli", the reverse of "ilmatto" or "the fool" in Italian.
This makes Stake to Your Heart (0) a representation of
Major Arcana card in reverse position, symbolizing shortsighted decisions, insecurity, brashness, impulsiveness, and recklessness.
This is reflected in its ability for the player to deviate from the standard gameplay formula by using gold to buy and sell their own weapons instead of using experience.
According to the game's code, the merchant's code name is labeled as EX_GLAUCUS. This suggests that the name of the merchant may be Glaucus.
